goal: Show the ticket_number after submitting feedback, attach telemetry sessionId to the feedback context, and add a 'Mis tickets' screen listing the user's own feedback tickets with status.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Submitting feedback shows a confirmation with a ticket_number formatted FB-XXXXXX
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/feedback.spec.ts: after successful submit, toast text matches /FB-\d{6}/

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Navigating to 'Mis tickets' shows the just-created ticket with status 'todo'
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/mis-tickets.spec.ts: submit feedback, navigate to Mis tickets, assert row with the ticket_number and a 'todo' status badge

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Submitting two feedbacks shows both in the list, ordered desc by created_at
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/mis-tickets.spec.ts: submit twice, assert order of rows matches reverse submission order

acceptance_criteria.criterion: With no tickets submitted, the list shows a visible empty state (no crash, no blank list)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/mis-tickets.spec.ts: reset mock store, navigate to Mis tickets with no prior submissions, assert empty-state text is visible

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /feedback payload's context.sessionId matches telemetry.ts's sessionId for that session
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/feedback.spec.ts: intercept the POST /feedback request, read body.context.sessionId, compare against the value telemetry emits in /telemetry/events session_start (same session)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: 'Mis tickets' is reachable from existing navigation (no orphan route)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: e2e/mis-tickets.spec.ts: navigate via the sidebar NavLink, not a raw page.goto

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unit/mock-server coverage: getTelemetrySessionId() getter, getMyFeedback() client, and mock GET /feedback/mine contract (ticket_number format, status default, sessionId stored, per-user filtering, desc order)
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test -- src/__tests__/telemetry.test.ts src/__tests__/api-feedback.test.ts && (cd mock-server && npx vitest run __tests__/feedback.test.js)
